review_candidates.description_excerpt: Are you a Senior DevOps with strong expertise in Kubernetes administration and managing Kafka infrastructure? Working with cutting edge technology enabling our Cloud Journey The Platform Core team is responsible for managing Infrastructure as Code for parts of our Core Platform Layer (Kubernetes Clusters, Message Broker backends, Infrastructure tooling), providing a distributed runtime platform that ensures optimal performance of our business web applications, APIs and backend services Building
eligibility_evidence: Are you currently based in Malta, or would you be open to relocating?
We offer a great relocation package, including a company apartment for the first month to help you settle in.

With more than 2,800 colleagues representing over 75 nationalities across a global network of offices - including 1,500 at our operational headquarters in Malta - every day brings new challenges and opportunities to grow.
It may not be for the faint-hearted, but if you thrive on innovation, enjoy pushing boundaries and want to be part of a diverse, international team, then you’ll fit right in at Betsson.
